info.title: EmDash CMS API
info.description: REST API for the EmDash CMS. All endpoints require authentication and return responses wrapped in a `{ success, data }` envelope.

post.summary: Take or refresh the entry's edit lock
post.description: Takes the lock for the caller, or reports who holds it. `heldByCaller` tells the two apart. The lease lasts seven minutes; repeating this call and every save on the entry extend it. `takeover` claims the lock from whoever holds it; their next heartbeat or save reports the new holder.

delete.description: Releases the lock only when the caller holds it; `released` is false otherwise.

get.description: Returns the redacted status of controlled Media Usage capture activation. This operation is read-only and does not start or resume activation. Requires `schema:manage`; bearer tokens also require the `admin` scope.

post.summary: Set the manual order of one sibling group of terms
post.description: `ids` names the terms to move, in the desired order, and may be a subset of the group — the listed terms are permuted within the positions they already occupy. A position belongs to a term across every locale, so there is no `locale` parameter. Ordering never reparents — use the term update endpoint to change a parent.

post.description: The request body is the package's `manifest.json`, byte for byte (at most 8 MiB). An optional `Idempotency-Key` header returns the existing operation on retry; reusing a key with a different manifest fails with `TRANSFER_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT`. The response lists the first files to upload. Session users need the `transfer:import` permission (admins); bearer tokens need `admin` or the scope named here. Scope: `transfer:analyze`.

200.description: Existing import for this idempotency key

get.description: Returns the import and how many of its files are uploaded. Session users need the `transfer:import` permission (admins); bearer tokens need `admin` or the scope named here. Scope: `transfer:analyze` or `transfer:execute`.

get.summary: List package files still to upload
get.description: Returns declared files that are not uploaded yet, in path order. Uploading an index chunk declares the files it lists, so list again after each round of uploads until the list is empty. Session users need the `transfer:import` permission (admins); bearer tokens need `admin` or the scope named here. Scope: `transfer:analyze`.

put.description: Streams one declared package file (`index/…`, `records/…`, or `media/…`; the path keeps its slashes). `Content-Length` is required and must equal the declared size, and the bytes must match the declared SHA-256. Media files may not exceed the site's `maxUploadSize`. Session users need the `transfer:import` permission (admins); bearer tokens need `admin` or the scope named here. Scope: `transfer:analyze`.

post.description: Runs one bounded analysis step once every file is uploaded. Call again after `nextRequestInMs` until it is null; the response then includes the plan and its digest. Submitted decisions are applied once the import is planned. Session users need the `transfer:import` permission (admins); bearer tokens need `admin` or the scope named here. Scope: `transfer:analyze`.

get.description: Session users need the `transfer:import` permission (admins); bearer tokens need `admin` or the scope named here. Scope: `transfer:analyze` or `transfer:execute`.

post.description: A step in progress stops after its current batch. Session users need the `transfer:import` permission (admins); bearer tokens need `admin` or the scope named here. Scope: `transfer:execute`.

post.summary: Abandon a failed or cancelled import
post.description: Lifts the site write fence after an import failed or was cancelled. Data the import already wrote stays in place. Session users need the `transfer:import` permission (admins); bearer tokens need `admin` or the scope named here. Scope: `transfer:execute`.

Starts a planned import once the reviewed package and plan digests match. The plan must have no blockers. Then call `advance` until `nextRequestInMs` is null. Session users need the `transfer:import` permission (admins); bearer tokens need `admin` or the scope named here. Scope: `transfer:execute`.

Runs one bounded import step. Retryable failures are recorded on the import and delay `nextRequestInMs`; it is null once the import has ended. While the import runs, and after it fails or is cancelled until it is abandoned, other site writes return 503 `TRANSFER_IMPORT_IN_PROGRESS`. Session users need the `transfer:import` permission (admins); bearer tokens need `admin` or the scope named here. Scope: `transfer:execute`.

get.description: The verified receipt of a complete import; its `receiptDigest` covers every other field. Session users need the `transfer:import` permission (admins); bearer tokens need `admin` or the scope named here. Scope: `transfer:analyze` or `transfer:execute`.
Returns exports newest first. Session users need the `transfer:export` permission (admins); bearer tokens need the `transfer:export` scope. Any holder of both can read any export.

post.description: Creates an export; call `advance` until `nextRequestInMs` is null. An optional `Idempotency-Key` header returns the existing export on retry. Session users need the `transfer:export` permission (admins); bearer tokens need the `transfer:export` scope. Any holder of both can read any export.

200.description: Existing export for this idempotency key

get.description: Session users need the `transfer:export` permission (admins); bearer tokens need the `transfer:export` scope. Any holder of both can read any export.

post.description: Runs one bounded export step; `nextRequestInMs` is null once the export has ended. Session users need the `transfer:export` permission (admins); bearer tokens need the `transfer:export` scope. Any holder of both can read any export.

get.description: The complete export's `manifest.json`, byte for byte; its SHA-256 is the package digest. Session users need the `transfer:export` permission (admins); bearer tokens need the `transfer:export` scope. Any holder of both can read any export.

Streams one index chunk, record chunk, or media blob listed by the export (the path keeps its slashes). `Content-Length` and the `ETag` (hex SHA-256) describe the file; the stream fails partway if the stored bytes no longer match. Session users need the `transfer:export` permission (admins); bearer tokens need the `transfer:export` scope. Any holder of both can read any export.

Streams the complete export as one `.emdash` tar archive, manifest first. On Workers the whole archive streams within one request; large sites should download files individually. Session users need the `transfer:export` permission (admins); bearer tokens need the `transfer:export` scope. Any holder of both can read any export.
Approval grants requested by MCP callers, newest first. Signed-in sessions only (`transfer:export` or `transfer:import`); bearer tokens are refused.
